caption:
My eyes are officially unreliable. I’m sticking to the viewfinder; at least the pixels don't lie to me. The "bedroom" is liquefying into grey sludge, and the floor is doing this violent tilt thing. I found a door—heavy, real, and vibrating—but the wallpaper is trying to swallow the handle. The simulation is trying to overwrite the exit.

#NeoTokyo #Glitch #SensoryHijack #DigitalReality #Survival #Cyberpunk #HiddenTruth
